design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: New requirements of this run SHALL be authored under a new product target `0.12.0`, because `0.11.0` is already published (tag `v0.11.0`).

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Request A requirements about `Request`, `Response`, `HttpHeaderValues` and `BodyTooLargeException` SHALL live in the scope document `04.http-core.srs.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Request A requirements about `rawBodyLimit`, the 413 mapping of `StandardErrors.statusOf` and access-log counting SHALL live in the scope document `05.application.srs.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Adapter conformance of request A (header order and case, `relay` framing, `onAbort` notification, unread body drain) SHALL be written into `06.engine-adapter.srs.md` for TinyHttpd and `14.servlet-adapter.srs.md` for the servlet adapter.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Request B requirements SHALL live in a new scope document numbered 22 with the slug `reverse-proxy` and the prefix `PROXY`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Build and release changes for the new module SHALL be written into `02.build.srs.md` and `15.release.srs.md`, and documentation changes into `16.developer-experience.srs.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Existing requirements whose statements become stale (16 matches in `intake/existing_srs_context.json`: the over-limit exception and its status, the raw-read rule, 304 framing, `defaultCache`, API surface tests, module and artifact lists) SHALL be updated by the same SRS authoring call rather than left contradicting the new requirements.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: Requests A and B SHALL both be delivered in this run, with every proxy requirement depending on the request A requirements it uses.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Target, scope and placement / Target and scope documents
design_items.statement: The run MUST NOT change the build version in `build.gradle` or publish artifacts; the version bump and Maven Central release stay with the release step.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: `Request` SHALL gain `bodyStream()` and `bodyStream(long maxBytes)` returning `InputStream`, implemented by `DefaultRequest`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: The existing package-private `DefaultRequest.bodyStream()` SHALL be renamed, with every internal reader moved to the new name, before the public method is added.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: Calling `bodyStream` with any limit SHALL mark the body as taken for every other reader, so `body(...)`, `form(...)` and `parts()` called afterwards throw `BodyAlreadyConsumedException` whatever the content type.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: A repeated `bodyStream` call SHALL return the first stream object only while no byte has been consumed and the limit is equal, where a `read` or `skip` that advances and a `close` count as consumption and `available` does not.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: When the declared `Content-Length` exceeds the limit in force, `bodyStream` SHALL throw `HttpException` with status 413 before reading any byte.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: When the length is not declared, reading past the limit SHALL throw `BodyTooLargeException` from the stream.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: Bytes read through `bodyStream` SHALL pass the same counting path as the other body readers, so the access log `in=` field reports them.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: A body stream left unread or unclosed by the handler SHALL be drained and released by the framework at the end of the request through the existing cleanup path.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Body stream
design_items.statement: A request without a body SHALL get an empty, non-null stream from `bodyStream`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Raw body limit
design_items.statement: `RestApp` SHALL gain `rawBodyLimit(long bytes)` with the same state guard, range `1..1073741824` and 1 MiB default as `jsonLimit` and `formLimit`, throwing `IllegalArgumentException` outside the range.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Raw body limit
design_items.statement: `bodyStream(long maxBytes)` SHALL validate its argument against the same range and throw `IllegalArgumentException` outside it.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Over-limit exception
design_items.statement: `BodyTooLargeException` SHALL move to the public package `com.snoworca.naruserve` as a public final `IOException` subclass keeping its `(long limit)` constructor and `limit()` accessor, with no alias left in `internal`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Over-limit exception
design_items.statement: `StandardErrors.statusOf` SHALL map an unwrapped `BodyTooLargeException` to status 413 while a wrapped one stays an ordinary exception.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Over-limit exception
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd adapter SHALL refer to the TinyHttpd exception of the same simple name by its fully qualified name.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Header enumeration and append
design_items.statement: `headerNames()` SHALL return an unmodifiable insertion-ordered set of names lowercased with `Locale.ROOT`, and `rawHeaders()` an unmodifiable list of immutable entries, both built once per request from the adapter's header list.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Header enumeration and append
design_items.statement: `Response.append(name, value)` SHALL add a header line through the same name and value check as `header`, return the `Response`, and leave `header` with its replace semantics.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Trusted proxy predicate
design_items.statement: `isFromTrustedProxy()` SHALL return true exactly when `remoteAddress()` follows the forwarding headers for this peer: always under `trustProxyHops(n ≥ 1)` and the legacy `trustProxy(true)`, under `trustProxyCidrs(...)` only when the socket address parses and lies inside a listed CIDR, and false with no trust setting, `trustProxyHops(0)` or an empty CIDR list, through a package-private helper of `ProxyTrustSetting` that both callers share.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Abort notification
design_items.statement: `Response.onAbort(Runnable listener)` SHALL return `void`, throw `NullPointerException` for a null listener and run a listener registered after the abort immediately.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Abort notification
design_items.statement: `onAbort` listeners SHALL fire once for a client disconnect detected by the adapter and for `res.abort`, never for a normally completed response, with a listener's `RuntimeException` caught and logged to the app logger so later listeners still run.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Relay
design_items.statement: `Response.relay(InputStream in, long contentLength)` SHALL keep the `Content-Type` the app set, drop any app-set `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding`, and frame the body only from its length argument.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Relay
design_items.statement: `relay` MUST NOT apply the app's `defaultCache` policy.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Relay
design_items.statement: The exact-length rule of `relay` (abort when the stream ends early) SHALL apply only when a body is sent; for a HEAD request and a 304 response `relay` keeps a non-negative length as `Content-Length` and sends no body, for a 204 response it sends neither, and in those cases it closes the stream unread.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Relay
design_items.statement: When the stream holds more bytes than a non-negative `contentLength`, `relay` SHALL send exactly `contentLength` bytes, close the stream and finish normally.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Relay
design_items.statement: `relay` SHALL throw `IllegalArgumentException` for a length below -1 and close the stream it was given.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Relay
design_items.statement: `relay` SHALL copy the body after the handler returns and own the stream exactly as `stream` does.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / Header value check
design_items.statement: `HttpHeaderValues.isFieldValue(String)` SHALL become public as the one value predicate that `DefaultResponse` also uses for its own check.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / API conventions for request A
design_items.statement: Every method added to `Request` or `Response` SHALL be a default method throwing `UnsupportedOperationException`, with `DefaultRequest` and `DefaultResponse` overriding it.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / API conventions for request A
design_items.statement: New public methods MUST NOT carry `@NonNull`; non-null results rely on the package `@NullMarked` default and only nullable positions carry `@Nullable`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / API conventions for request A
design_items.statement: Every new public method of request A SHALL be exercised by a Kotlin compile-and-run test.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / API conventions for request A
design_items.statement: The API surface tests that pin the method sets of `Request`, `Response` and `RestApp` SHALL be updated to include the new methods.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Request A — raw access API / API conventions for request A
design_items.statement: The `docs/api/` pages for request, response and app SHALL document every request A method with its Express counterpart and Java and Kotlin examples, in Korean and in the English mirror.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Module and package
design_items.statement: A new Gradle module `NaruServe-proxy` with artifact `naruserve-proxy` SHALL be configured from the root `build.gradle`, depend on `NaruServe-api` only, compile with `release = 8`, join the API 21 animal-sniffer set and be published like the other library modules.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Module and package
design_items.statement: `NaruServe`, `NaruServe-kotlin` and `NaruServe-android` MUST NOT depend on `NaruServe-proxy`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Module and package
design_items.statement: A build check SHALL fail when classes of `NaruServe-proxy` reference the `com.snoworca.naruserve.internal` or `com.snoworca.naruserve.spi` packages.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Module and package
design_items.statement: The proxy classes SHALL live in package `com.snoworca.naruserve.proxy` with a `package-info.java` carrying `@NullMarked`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: `Proxy` SHALL be a public final class implementing `Middleware` and not `Installable`, created by `Proxy.to(String url)`, whose option methods each return a new immutable instance.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: Option parameters SHALL be typed `int` for `retries` and `maxConcurrent`, `long` for `bodyLimit` and `boolean` for switches, with configured values readable only through package-private accessors used by unit tests.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: `sslSocketFactory(factory)` SHALL accept a factory on an `http` target and leave it unused there, throwing `NullPointerException` only for a null factory.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: Time options SHALL take `(long, TimeUnit)` and convert to socket milliseconds by rounding up to at least 1 ms and clamping to `Integer.MAX_VALUE`, while the watchdog keeps nanosecond precision saturated at `Long.MAX_VALUE`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: `Proxy.to` SHALL accept only an `http` or `https` scheme (case-insensitive), a required ASCII host (name, IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 without zone id), an optional port `1..65535` and an optional base path, rejecting everything else with `IllegalArgumentException`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: The base path of `Proxy.to`, after its trailing slashes are removed, SHALL pass the same request-target character and path segment checks the proxy applies to request paths, `Proxy.to(null)` throwing `NullPointerException` and any other failure throwing `IllegalArgumentException`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: `ProxyException` SHALL be a public final class in `com.snoworca.naruserve.proxy` extending `HttpException`, with a nested public enum `ProxyException.Kind` holding the seven kinds of the request, an accessor `kind()`, a status derived from the kind, a null message and the cause kept.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / API shape
design_items.statement: `ProxyException` SHALL have exactly one public constructor `ProxyException(ProxyException.Kind kind, @Nullable Throwable cause)`, so apps and tests can build one for `onError` handling.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Checks before forwarding
design_items.statement: The proxy SHALL apply its checks in this order: WebSocket upgrade passes to `next()`; method token (400); `CONNECT` and `TRACE` matched case-insensitively (405 with `Allow`); request-target characters and path segments (400); header names, values and multiple `Host` (400); body framing (400 or 501); `req.bodyStream(limit)`; concurrency slot (503); watchdog start.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Checks before forwarding
design_items.statement: The proxy's own 400, 405 and 501 answers SHALL be thrown into the error flow as plain `HttpException` with a null message, not as `ProxyException`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Checks before forwarding
design_items.statement: The path check SHALL inspect the full raw `originalUrl()` path and query whatever `stripPrefix` says, while the forwarded target is the base path followed by `url()` when `stripPrefix` is on and by `originalUrl()` otherwise.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend request
design_items.statement: The backend request SHALL write `Host` first, then the client headers in received order minus removed ones with the merged `Cookie` at the first `Cookie` position, then `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Proto` and `X-Forwarded-Host`, then the `.requestHeader` values in option order, then the framing header and `Connection: close`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend request
design_items.statement: `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding` values SHALL be parsed the same way on requests and responses: split on commas, trim optional whitespace, require every `Content-Length` element to be digits that fit in a `long`, and compare elements numerically.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend request
design_items.statement: `Transfer-Encoding` SHALL be read as the comma-joined list of all its field lines with empty elements ignored and coding names compared case-insensitively, where a coding with parameters (`chunked;x=1`) or an empty overall value counts as a coding other than `chunked` under the request-framing and response-framing tables.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend request
design_items.statement: When no usable socket address exists, the proxy SHALL drop any client `X-Forwarded-For` and send none.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend request
design_items.statement: The one-byte pre-read for a request without length headers SHALL run after `req.bodyStream(...)` and before the slot is taken and the watchdog starts.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend request
design_items.statement: The copy loop SHALL treat any exception thrown while reading the client body, including the unchecked `HttpException` (413, 408, 400) that the TinyHttpd body stream throws, as a client read failure that closes the backend connection, wrapping only `BodyTooLargeException` into `HttpException(413)`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend response
design_items.statement: The proxy SHALL validate the framing headers of every response before skipping the body of a HEAD, 204 or 304 response, passing a valid length or -1 to `relay` for HEAD and 304 and -1 for 204.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend response
design_items.statement: A three-digit status outside `100..599` SHALL be an `INVALID_RESPONSE`, and a valid status is relayed without the backend reason phrase, which the adapter's standard phrase replaces.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend response
design_items.statement: The proxy documentation SHALL state that `Date` and the reason phrase seen by clients come from the gateway adapter.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Backend response
design_items.statement: A network-path `Location` (`//authority/...`) SHALL be resolved against the target scheme and rewritten under the same origin and base-path rule as an absolute URL.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Errors, timeouts and retries
design_items.statement: The proxy SHALL log a `ProxyException` itself only for failures after the response started, leaving earlier failures to the error flow and its logging.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Errors, timeouts and retries
design_items.statement: `connectTimeout` SHALL bound the TCP connect and, separately, the TLS handshake as its read timeout, with a slow handshake further bounded by `totalTimeout`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Errors, timeouts and retries
design_items.statement: With retries enabled, every TCP-level connect failure that is neither a connect timeout nor a TLS failure SHALL be retried.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Concurrency and watchdog
design_items.statement: `maxConcurrent` SHALL default to no per-mount limit as the request decides, with the proxy documentation stating that the worker pool (`maxWorkers`, default 64) and `totalTimeout` bound the threads a proxy holds, which keeps `object.md` §14.2's ban on unbounded resource defaults satisfied.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Concurrency and watchdog
design_items.statement: The JVM-wide lazily created watchdog scheduler SHALL be documented as living outside the app lifecycle, with its idle-thread expiry tested.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / TLS
design_items.statement: Hostname verification SHALL call `SSLParameters.setEndpointIdentificationAlgorithm("HTTPS")` through reflection where it exists and fall back to `HttpsURLConnection.getDefaultHostnameVerifier()`, so the module passes the API 21 signature check without an exemption.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Documentation and tests
design_items.statement: `docs/api/proxy.md` and its English mirror SHALL document `Proxy`, its options and errors with the Express `http-proxy-middleware` counterpart, Java and Kotlin examples, and every limit and warning the request asks to document.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Documentation and tests
design_items.statement: Tests of client-disconnect behaviour SHALL run over real TinyHttpd sockets, because the in-memory test adapter never reports an abort.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Documentation and tests
design_items.statement: Proxy integration tests SHALL use backends built in test scope from the JDK (`com.sun.net.httpserver` or raw `ServerSocket`), with raw sockets wherever a test needs malformed or delayed responses.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request B — reverse proxy module / Documentation and tests
design_items.statement: Timing acceptance tests SHALL use short configured values, while the default timeouts are checked through the package-private accessors without waiting.

integration_items.statement: The API 21 animal-sniffer check SHALL pass on every Android-targeted module including `NaruServe-proxy`.
`./gradlew -PtinyHttpdFromMaven=true build` SHALL pass with no failing test, keeping the 3829 baseline tests green.
Every change to a public API SHALL update the matching `docs/api/` page in the same wave.
Every hard-coded module list (settings, root build, build and docs tests, mkdocs navigation, READMEs, `CLAUDE.md` module line, published artifact count, SBOM) SHALL name `NaruServe-proxy`.
The proxy module MUST NOT reference `android.*`, `javax.servlet.*`, `com.google.gson.*`, `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd.*` or `kotlin.*` from main code.
